Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a fundamental logical error in the initial task breakdown. The question asks to compare the birth dates of the directors named "Slim Carter" and "Thendral Veesum." The Planner incorrectly interpreted "Slim Carter" and "Thendral Veesum" as the names of the *directors* themselves, rather than the names of the *films*. Consequently, the entire search strategy was flawed from the start, leading the WebSurfer to search for the birth years of directors *of films* with those titles (Richard Bartlett and B.S. Ranga) instead of searching for the birth years of individuals actually named Slim Carter and Thendral Veesum. This misinterpretation of the subject of the comparison is the root cause of the incorrect solution.
